in_sanskrit.name: Braja
in_sanskrit.meaning: Rashtra or country, joy or delight
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: One who is from or belongs to Braj, a place of joy and delight.

in_hindi.name: Brajeesh
in_hindi.long_meaning: Lord of Braj, a place of joy and delight.

in_marathi.name: Brajesh
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Lord of Braja
in_marathi.long_meaning: Brajesh हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Brajesh is a Sanskrit name derived from the words ‘Braja’ (a place of Lord Krishna) and ‘Ish’ (God). This name signifies one who is the lord of Braja or Lord Krishna himself.

in_bengali.name: Brajesh
in_bengali.meaning: হিন্দু নাম যার অর্থ Lord of Braja
in_bengali.long_meaning: Brajesh একটি হিন্দু নাম যা ভারতীয় সংস্কৃতিতে গভীর আধ্যাত্মিক তাৎপর্য রাখে। Brajesh is a Sanskrit name derived from the words ‘Braja’ (a place of Lord Krishna) and ‘Ish’ (God). This name signifies one who is the lord of Braja or Lord Krishna himself.
